summary_md: **洛小宸Lucien ([@LucienAIlab](https://x.com/LucienAIlab/status/2116116871040885044))** made a 90-year Moscow Metro history animation using the subway style in the **lemo-opuscar** Claude Code film-style toolbox, noting it was hard to tune and a 2-minute video used about 30% of a weekly Pro quota ([lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar](https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar)).
